abstract: A 24-year-old man admitted to our hospital because of hemoptysis and left precordial pain. Chest X-ray and chest CT scan showed a mass in the left anterosuperior mediastinum. Laboratory examination revealed elevated levels of AFP (550 ng/ml), which were highly indicative of malignant germ cell tumor. Imaging examination indicated that the mass was resectable, so surgery was performed prior to chemotherapy. Histological examination revealed an admixture of seminoma, immature teratoma, embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor. Because the resection performed was incomplete, the patient received three courses of combination chemotherapy consisting of CDDP, VP-16 and BLM and 40 Gy irradiation. The serum level of AFP was normal after one course of combination chemotherapy. The patient has shown no sign of recurrence for 3 years since surgery.
abstract_ja: 24歳男性が喀血と左前胸部痛を主訴に当院を受診した。胸部X線と胸部CTで左前上縦隔に腫瘤を認めた。検査でAFP(550 ng/ml)が高値を示し、悪性胚細胞腫瘍が強く疑われた。画像上腫瘍は切除可能と判断されたため、化学療法に先立ち手術を行った。組織学的には、セミノーマ、未熟奇形腫、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍の混在であった。切除は不完全であったため、CDDP、VP-16、BLMによる併用化学療法3コースと40 Gyの照射を施行した。AFP値は化学療法1コース後に正常化した。術後3年間再発の徴候はない。
